For each testing type selected for this project, define its Objective, Technique, and Completion Criteria. Remove types not applicable; add types specific to your project (e.g. Regression Testing, Compatibility Testing).
[State what functional testing verifies — e.g. every feature, business rule, and API endpoint behaves according to SRS AC-xx and NAC-xx specifications.]

[List techniques used, e.g.: · State Transition — for order lifecycle, workflow states · Equivalence Partitioning (EP) — for input domain partitioning · Boundary Value Analysis (BVA) — for all numeric constraints · Branch Coverage (BC) + Condition Coverage (CC) — for business rule logic]
[e.g. All P1 test cases pass. No open P1/P2 defects. 100% AC-xx coverage for all features. Branch Coverage ≥ 80% in service layer.]
[State what integration testing verifies — e.g. services integrate correctly with real DB, message broker, and cache. Verify transaction boundaries and idempotency.]

[e.g.: · Testcontainers for real infrastructure (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis) · WireMock for external API stubs · Concurrency tests (CountDownLatch) for shared resource contention · AFTER_COMMIT boundary verification · Idempotency tests: same event_id sent twice → no duplicate]
[e.g. All integration tests pass. Zero data inconsistency. Idempotency verified for all async consumers. Atomic rollback confirmed.]
[State NFR targets to verify — e.g. system meets response time and throughput requirements under expected and peak load.]
[e.g.: · k6 Load Test: ramp to target VUs → steady state → ramp-down · k6 Stress Test: ramp to peak VUs to find breaking point · Separate cold-cache and warm-cache runs for cached endpoints]
[e.g. NFR-P01: p95 < Xms at N VUs. NFR-S01: no HTTP 5xx at peak VUs. Error rate < 0.5% in all load tests.]
[State security requirements to verify — e.g. system protected against OWASP Top 10; all NFR-SEC requirements met.]

[e.g.: · OWASP ZAP automated scan · REST Assured manual security tests: JWT tampering, brute force, SQL injection, CORS check · DB inspection for cryptographic compliance (bcrypt cost, no plaintext secrets)]
[e.g. No Critical or High OWASP findings. All NFR-SEC requirements verified. Account lockout after N failures confirmed.]
[State the UAT goal — e.g. confirm the system meets business requirements through realistic end-to-end scenarios executed by the Product Owner or business representative.]
[e.g.: · Script-based UAT using business-language test scripts (SC-01..SC-NN) · Exploratory testing by end users for usability · Business scenario walkthrough (end-to-end value stream)]
[e.g. All UAT scenarios executed and signed off by Product Owner. No critical business process blockers. Written sign-off document obtained.]
